title: Visão geral
description: O dia de cada área com a curva diária do período, o Energy Score e o registro mais recente de cada Health Category, pela hora local de cada registro.

targets.rawSql:
with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local,
         now() at time zone '$__timezone' as now_local
),
days as (
  select day
  from period,
       generate_series(read_model.local_bucket('day', from_local),
                       read_model.local_bucket('day', least(to_local, now_local)),
                       interval '1 day') as day
  where day < to_local
),
metric as (
  select read_model.local_bucket('day', period_start_local) as day, avg(score) as value
  from read_model.current_energy_score, period
  where period_start_local >= from_local and period_start_local < to_local
  group by 1
)
select d.day at time zone '$__timezone' as time,
       m.value as "Energy Score"
from days d
left join metric m on m.day = d.day
order by 1

with period as (
  select $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as from_local,
         $__timeTo()::timestamptz at time zone '$__timezone' as to_local,
         now() at time zone '$__timezone' as now_local
),
days as (
  select day
  from period,
       generate_series(read_model.local_bucket('day', from_local),
                       read_model.local_bucket('day', least(to_local, now_local)),
                       interval '1 day') as day
  where day < to_local
    and day >= (select read_model.local_bucket('day', min(window_start)) from read_model.current_hourly_steps)
),
metric as (
  select read_model.local_bucket('day', window_start) as day, sum(steps) as value
  from read_model.current_hourly_steps, period
  where window_start >= from_local and window_start < to_local
  group by 1
),
goal as (
  select day::timestamp as day, steps as goal
  from read_model.current_daily_goal, period
  where goal = 'steps_goal' and day >= from_local::date and day < to_local
)
select d.day at time zone '$__timezone' as time,
       coalesce(m.value, 0) as "Passos",
       coalesce(m.value, 0) * 100.0 / nullif(g.goal, 0) as "% da meta"
from days d
left join metric m on m.day = d.day
left join goal g on g.day = d.day
order by 1

panels.title: Dado mais recente
panels.description: O registro mais recente de cada Health Category, pela hora local do próprio registro, qualquer que seja o período.

targets.rawSql:
with sources as (
  select 1 as area_order, 'Energy Score' as area, 1 as category_order, 'Energy Score' as category,
         period_start_local as local_time, period_start as instant
  from read_model.current_energy_score
  union all
  select 2, 'Atividade', 1, 'Passos', window_end, (window_end - cast(observed_at_offset as interval)) at time zone 'UTC'
  from read_model.current_hourly_steps
  union all
  select 2, 'Atividade', 2, 'Atividade', window_end, (window_end - cast(observed_at_offset as interval)) at time zone 'UTC'
  from read_model.current_hourly_activity_summary
  union all
  select 2, 'Atividade', 3, 'Andares', coalesce(period_end_local, period_start_local), coalesce(period_end, period_start)
  from read_model.current_floors_climbed
  union all
  select 3, 'Exercício', 1, 'Exercício', coalesce(period_end_local, period_start_local), coalesce(period_end, period_start)
  from read_model.current_exercise
  union all
  select 4, 'Sono', 1, 'Sono', coalesce(period_end_local, period_start_local), coalesce(period_end, period_start)
  from read_model.current_sleep
  union all
  select 4, 'Sono', 2, 'Apneia do sono', coalesce(period_end_local, period_start_local), coalesce(period_end, period_start)
  from read_model.current_sleep_apnea
  union all
  select 5, 'Coração e sinais vitais', 1, 'Frequência cardíaca', coalesce(period_end_local, period_start_local), coalesce(period_end, period_start)
  from read_model.current_heart_rate
  union all
  select 5, 'Coração e sinais vitais', 2, 'SpO2', coalesce(period_end_local, period_start_local), coalesce(period_end, period_start)
  from read_model.current_blood_oxygen
  union all
  select 5, 'Coração e sinais vitais', 3, 'Temperatura da pele', coalesce(period_end_local, period_start_local), coalesce(period_end, period_start)
  from read_model.current_skin_temperature
)
select distinct on (area_order, category_order)
       area as "Área",
       category as "Health Category",
       to_char(local_time, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') as "Registro mais recente",
       extract(epoch from now() - instant) as "Há quanto tempo"
from sources
order by area_order, category_order, local_time desc, instant desc
